title: Taisei Corporation shapes the next generation of talent with AI
summary: Taisei Corporation’s HR team is leading the rollout of ChatGPT Enterprise to drive AI-powered talent development across the organization.
body: Taisei Corporation’s HR team is leading the rollout of ChatGPT Enterprise to drive AI-powered talent development across the organization.
summaryZh: 日本大成建设公司的HR团队正在积极推进ChatGPT Enterprise的企业级部署，旨在借助生成式人工智能技术驱动全公司范围内的人才培养与发展。该案例展示了AI大模型在传统大型工程建设企业的实际应用成效。
